reranked_evidence.title: How community benefit agreements can mitigate public concerns about data centers
reranked_evidence.snippet:
How community benefit agreements can mitigate public concerns about data centers
Brookings Institution
167000 subscribers
17 likes
1087 views
18 Feb 2026
The Center for Technology Innovation (CTI) at Brookings will host a webinar to discuss new CTI research detailing how local leaders can use community benefit agreements to address public concerns to ensure companies are more transparent, fair, and equitable as they build new data centers for AI expansion. Following a discussion of the report, Brookings CTI Senior Fellows Nicol Turner Lee and Darrell West will lead a discussion with several experts on what communities can do to address local concerns, understand the costs and benefits of data centers, and reach concrete agreements that protect community interests.
